g.text: /ggx-dispatcher · /route picks the lane → /dev:ff opens the PR

a.data-tip-desc-zh: Atomic decision command. Reads the ticket classification label (bug / port / feature) and fans it out into the one pipeline entry-point to run next.
a.data-tip-desc-en: Atomic decision command. Reads the ticket classification label (bug / port / feature) and fans it out into the one pipeline entry-point to run next.

a.data-tip-desc-zh: Port features from an origin repo into the monorepo. Seven stages, three waves, four relay agents (dev-consult / pm / designer / synth) producing OpenSpec artifacts.
a.data-tip-desc-en: Port features from an origin repo into the monorepo. Seven stages, three waves, four relay agents (dev-consult / pm / designer / synth) producing OpenSpec artifacts.

a.data-tip-desc-zh: Drive a ready-to-dev ticket all the way to a PR. Nine atomic stages, Figma provenance, HITL gates, and dual --auto / default modes.
a.data-tip-desc-en: Drive a ready-to-dev ticket all the way to a PR. Nine atomic stages, Figma provenance, HITL gates, and dual --auto / default modes.

a.data-tip-desc-zh: Bug-fix fast lane. Same as /dev:ff with the bug flag: skips the OpenSpec figma / detect / align / apply stages and runs the human-write-fix walker.
a.data-tip-desc-en: Bug-fix fast lane. Same as /dev:ff with the bug flag: skips the OpenSpec figma / detect / align / apply stages and runs the human-write-fix walker.

a.data-tip-desc-zh: Two fuses against hallucination: /spec-lint (nine deterministic checks) plus /spec-review (the human final gate). Synthesis errors are caught here.
a.data-tip-desc-en: Two fuses against hallucination: /spec-lint (nine deterministic checks) plus /spec-review (the human final gate). Synthesis errors are caught here.

a.data-tip-desc-zh: A review baseline with zero human cost. A scheduled remote agent runs every day and posts results back as PR comments.
a.data-tip-desc-en: A review baseline with zero human cost. A scheduled remote agent runs every day and posts results back as PR comments.
